description: Just making Space another familiar place to everyone through stories
summary: We developed an illustrated story. It addresses the exploration of Mars using rovers and other tools, and mainly how they have contributed to making milestones though they have been left in space.
details: Our illustrative story depicts instances of the rovers undertaking mission on Mars. It helps present the realities of Mars exploration in an engaging manner using storytelling and illustration. Its aim is to introduce these facts to a younger audience about how Mars exploration leaves certain equipment left in space and how the roles of such equipment in those discoveries. We used Canva for the illustrations and compilation and Google Docs for the drafting and writing. Our project combined our respective skills in art and storytelling to transform facts and data into a narrative piece. We considered making the fact as true as possible while still making it engaging. We also considered turning the real images we got from our sources into cartoon versions for the illustrations, using Gemini. And finally, we cross checked our facts with the original sources.
